items.title: Altria (NYSE:MO) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Tobacco company Altria (NYSE:MO) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 15.5% year on year to $6.11 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.48 per share was 1.2% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Altria (MO) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Lag Estimates
items.summary: Altria (MO) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -1.33% and -0.11%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
